question: Under Missouri LAGERS' private markets consultant RFP, how many public fund clients of what minimum size must a respondent provide non-discretionary private market investment consulting to?
expected_facts: At least three public fund clients with assets of at least $10 billion (as of March 31, 2024).
acceptance: At least three public-fund clients with at least $10bn each. March31,2024 is a useful qualifier, not a separately asked fact.

prior_reviews.reason: This is a Boston Retirement System RFP attachment, not Missouri LAGERS’ private markets consultant RFP. Its request for up to 10 public-fund references with assets greater than $1 billion does not establish a requirement to provide non-discretionary private-market consulting to at least three public funds with at least $10 billion each.
quotes: BOSTON RETIREMENT SYSTEM Investment Consulting Services Request for Proposals
Provide a list of up to 10 current public fund clients with assets greater than $1 billion for whom work similar to that requested in this RFP has been performed by your firm.
